stem.text: The nucleus of a radioactive isotope of an element emits an $\alpha$-particle. The daughter nucleus then emits a $\beta^{-}$ particle and then the daughter nucleus of that reaction emits another $\beta^{-}$ particle.
Which statement describes the final nuclide that is formed?

A.text: It is a different isotope of the original element.

B.text: It is a nuclide of a different element of higher proton number.

C.text: It is a nuclide of the same element but with different proton number.

D.text: It is identical to the original nuclide.
